actions.name: scan_room_planes
actions.title: Scan Room Planes
actions.description: Reads detected WebXR vertical wall planes in centimeters or returns the three calibrated virtual gallery walls (420x280 cm, 360x280 cm, 360x280 cm). Precondition: XR session active or virtual twin initialized. Example: scan_room_planes({ source: 'virtual_twin' }). Follows the six-step Curatorial Onboarding and Compliance Protocol.

source.description: Source of wall planes: 'webxr_plane' for detected physical boundaries or 'virtual_twin' for default calibrated gallery walls.

actions.name: toggle_passthrough_wall_mode
actions.title: Toggle Passthrough Wall Mode
actions.description: Switches passthrough active state and view mode between 1:1 physical room passthrough and virtual gallery elevation. Precondition: WebXR immersive-ar session available or virtual studio fallback ready. Example: toggle_passthrough_wall_mode({ enabled: true }).

enabled.description: True to enable passthrough room mode; false for pure virtual gallery rendering.

actions.name: toggle_seated_scale_twin
actions.title: Toggle Seated Scale Twin
actions.description: Activates or stows the 1:8 miniature tabletop gallery maquette floating 55 cm ahead inside a 60 cm (2 ft) seated reach sphere. Precondition: Exhibition store initialized. Example: toggle_seated_scale_twin({ enabled: true }).

enabled.description: True to activate the 1:8 scale tabletop maquette, false to stow.

actions.name: load_iiif_collection
actions.title: Load IIIF Collection
actions.description: Parses an untrusted IIIF Presentation v2/v3 JSON string or loads the bundled 24-work Art Institute of Chicago CC0 catalog with physical centimeter dimensions and 50/200 lux ceilings. Precondition: Valid network or bundled collection access. Example: load_iiif_collection({ useBundledDefault: true }).

manifestJson.description: Raw IIIF Presentation JSON string to parse and sanitize into museum catalog items.

useBundledDefault.description: True to load the bundled 24-artwork Art Institute of Chicago open access collection.

actions.name: filter_curatorial_theme
actions.title: Filter Curatorial Theme
actions.description: Ranks catalog artworks against curatorial brief keywords, theme ('botanical', 'architectural', 'impressionist', 'modernist'), and optional conservation maxLuxCeiling (50 or 200 lux). To find specific artists or titles, pass query with their names; those works are always included and listed first. Precondition: Catalog populated. Example: filter_curatorial_theme({ brief: 'Architectural etchings', theme: 'architectural', query: 'Piranesi Wright' }).

brief.description: Curator brief describing the exhibition goals and aesthetic direction.

theme.description: Target curatorial theme to filter by.

maxLuxCeiling.description: Maximum allowable lux ceiling (50 lux for light-sensitive paper, 200 lux for oil on canvas).

query.description: Optional artist, title or medium keywords such as 'Piranesi Wright'; works that match are always included and listed first.

actions.name: propose_wall_layout
actions.title: Propose Wall Layout
actions.description: Computes a parametric wall hang ('chronological_spine', 'salon_cluster', 'symmetrical_pair') on wallIdOrName for artworkIds, verifying clearance and margins. Precondition: Target wall exists and artworkIds are present in catalog. Example: propose_wall_layout({ wallIdOrName: 'wall-north', artworkIds: ['art-1', 'art-2'], template: 'chronological_spine' }).

wallIdOrName.description: Target wall identifier or human-readable wall name (e.g. 'North Limestone Gallery Wall').

artworkIds.description: Array of catalog artwork IDs to place on the wall.

actions.name: place_framed_artwork
actions.title: Place Framed Artwork
actions.description: Mounts a single framed artwork onto target wall at center coordinates (centerX_cm, centerY_cm) with track spotlight illuminance in lux, creating an accompanying museum placard. Precondition: Target wall and artwork catalog entry exist. Example: place_framed_artwork({ wallIdOrName: 'wall-north', artworkIdOrTitle: 'art-1', centerX_cm: 210, centerY_cm: 148, spotLux: 45 }).

wallIdOrName.description: Target wall identifier or human-readable name.

artworkIdOrTitle.description: Artwork catalog identifier or artwork title.

centerX_cm.description: Horizontal position of frame center along wall in centimeters.

centerY_cm.description: Vertical position of frame center above gallery floor in centimeters.

spotLux.description: Spotlight illuminance in lux (15 to 300 lux).

actions.name: adjust_frame_height
actions.title: Adjust Frame Height
actions.description: Moves a mounted framed artwork vertically (centerY_cm in cm, optional centerX_cm in cm) and synchronizes its museum placard height. Precondition: Mount exists on an active wall. Example: adjust_frame_height({ mountIdOrTitle: 'mount-1', centerY_cm: 145 }).

mountIdOrTitle.description: Mounted artwork identifier or artwork title.

centerY_cm.description: New vertical center height above floor in centimeters.

centerX_cm.description: Optional new horizontal center position along wall in centimeters.

actions.name: reflow_wall_spacing
actions.title: Reflow Wall Spacing
actions.description: Runs reflowWallMounts across target wall so every adjacent frame and placard clears minGap_cm (default 18 cm, rule floor 15 cm) and 20 cm wall margins. Precondition: Target wall has at least one mounted work. Example: reflow_wall_spacing({ wallIdOrName: 'wall-north', minGap_cm: 18 }).

wallIdOrName.description: Target wall identifier or human-readable name.

minGap_cm.description: Minimum gap between adjacent frames and placards in centimeters (default 18 cm).

actions.name: set_spot_illumination
actions.title: Set Spot Illumination
actions.description: Sets track spotlight illuminance in lux (15 to 300 lux) on target mount to satisfy 50 lux paper or 200 lux canvas conservation ceilings. Precondition: Target mount exists. Example: set_spot_illumination({ mountIdOrTitle: 'mount-1', spotLux: 45 }).

mountIdOrTitle.description: Mounted artwork identifier or artwork title.

spotLux.description: Target illuminance in lux (15 to 300 lux).

actions.name: compute_sightline_frustum
actions.title: Compute Sightline Frustum
actions.description: Computes 152 cm standing and 115 cm wheelchair 3D sightline cones, upward pitch angles in degrees, and angular placard legibility across the active gallery. Precondition: Exhibition has mounts placed. Example: compute_sightline_frustum({ wallIdOrName: 'wall-north' }).

wallIdOrName.description: Optional wall identifier or name to filter sightline cones.

actions.name: preview_wheelchair_eye_level
actions.title: Preview Wheelchair Eye Level
actions.description: Shifts active viewMode to wheelchair_115 (115 cm eye height) or standing_152 (152 cm eye height) and selects optional mount to frame in 3D. Precondition: Exhibition store initialized. Example: preview_wheelchair_eye_level({ enabled: true, mountIdOrTitle: 'mount-1' }).

enabled.description: True for 115 cm seated wheelchair perspective; false for 152 cm standing.

mountIdOrTitle.description: Optional mounted artwork identifier or title to frame in focus.

actions.name: validate_ada_compliance
actions.title: Validate ADA Compliance
actions.description: Runs full seven-rule SightlineTruthEngine audit, returning all errors and warnings with measured centimeter, degree, and lux values and suggested repair calls. Precondition: Exhibition store initialized. Example: validate_ada_compliance({ wallIdOrName: 'wall-north' }).

wallIdOrName.description: Optional wall identifier or name to restrict audit.

actions.name: check_fov_label_legibility
actions.title: Check FoV Label Legibility
actions.description: Evaluates W3C XAUR placard angular font height (>= 1.2 degrees at 120 cm viewing distance) and verifies floating HUD offsets stay inside 30x22 degree central headset FoV cone. Precondition: Mounts with placards exist. Example: check_fov_label_legibility({ mountIdOrTitle: 'mount-1' }).

mountIdOrTitle.description: Optional mounted artwork identifier or title to evaluate.

actions.name: repair_layout_violation
actions.title: Repair Layout Violation
actions.description: Repairs every open ADA and conservation error in one call with repairAll: true, or one issue or mount at a time. Pass repairAll: true to fix every open error in one call (frame height, lighting, placard height and spacing, print size). Or pass issueId from validate_ada_compliance to fix that one issue with its recommended correction, or name a mount with explicit targets (targetCenterY_cm, targetSpotLux, targetFontHeight_mm, targetPlacardCenterY_cm, reflowWall). Precondition: the exhibition has mounted works. Example: repair_layout_violation({ repairAll: true }).

mountIdOrTitle.description: Target mount identifier or artwork title.

targetCenterY_cm.description: Corrected vertical centerline height above gallery floor in centimeters.

targetSpotLux.description: Corrected track spotlight illuminance in lux.

targetFontHeight_mm.description: Corrected placard font height in millimeters (e.g. 28 mm).

targetPlacardCenterY_cm.description: Corrected placard centerline height in centimeters (reach band 120 to 140 cm).

repairAll.description: True to repair every open error issue in one call using each issue's recommended correction.

reflowWall.description: True to execute automatic horizontal wall spacing reflow after repositioning.

actions.name: draft_curatorial_placard
actions.title: Draft Curatorial Placard
actions.description: Writes a museum placard (curatorialNote) of 45 to 70 words (notes outside 40 to 75 words are rejected, so count before sending) and sets fontHeight_mm (>= 26 mm for >= 1.2 degree legibility) on target mount. Count your words before sending; about 50 words is a safe target. Precondition: Target mount exists. Example: draft_curatorial_placard({ mountIdOrTitle: 'mount-1', curatorialNote: '<about 50 words of interpretive text>', fontHeight_mm: 28 }).

mountIdOrTitle.description: Target mounted artwork identifier or title.

curatorialNote.description: Interpretive wall text copy of 45 to 70 words.

fontHeight_mm.description: Placard font height in millimeters (minimum 26 mm, recommended 28 mm).

actions.name: swap_rejected_artwork
actions.title: Swap Rejected Artwork
actions.description: Replaces currently selected mounted artwork with replacementArtworkIdOrTitle matching exhibition theme and lux ceiling, routing through ApprovalGate. Precondition: An artwork mount is currently selected. Example: swap_rejected_artwork({ replacementArtworkIdOrTitle: 'art-3' }).

replacementArtworkIdOrTitle.description: Identifier or title of replacement catalog artwork.

mountIdOrTitle.description: Optional mount identifier or title (defaults to currently selected mount).

actions.name: pin_spatial_anchor
actions.title: Pin Spatial Anchor
actions.description: Requests curator approval via ApprovalGate before locking SpatialAnchorRecord and saving physical gallery wall drill coordinates. Precondition: Target wall has finalized mounts and zero truth errors. Example: pin_spatial_anchor({ wallIdOrName: 'wall-north', label: 'North Wall Final Hang Schedule' }).

wallIdOrName.description: Target wall identifier or human-readable wall name.

label.description: Descriptive label for persistent spatial anchor.

actions.name: scrub_timeline_snapshot
actions.title: Scrub Timeline Snapshot
actions.description: Saves a named curatorial milestone (mode: 'save') or restores a prior milestone (mode: 'restore', snapshotIdOrLabel). Precondition: Exhibition store initialized. Example: scrub_timeline_snapshot({ mode: 'save', label: 'Initial Hang Proposal' }).

mode.description: Timeline operation: 'save' to commit a new snapshot, or 'restore' to roll back.

label.description: Descriptive milestone label when mode is 'save'.

snapshotIdOrLabel.description: Snapshot identifier or label when mode is 'restore'.

actions.name: export_exhibition_manifest
actions.title: Export Exhibition Manifest
actions.description: Exports a complete JSON hang schedule with wall coordinates in cm, spotlight settings in lux, sightline pitches in degrees, spatial anchors, and IIIF attributions. Precondition: Exhibition has walls and mounts defined. Example: export_exhibition_manifest({ includeAttributions: true }).

includeAttributions.description: True to include full IIIF provenance and CC0 licensing attributions.
